title: Fix three bugs in a Go integer stack
description: A Go Stack has three bugs: Peek returns the bottom element, Pop doesn't shrink the slice, and IsEmpty condition is negated.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in stack.go:
1. `Pop`: add `s.data = s.data[:len(s.data)-1]` after capturing top, before returning
2. `Peek`: change `s.data[0]` to `s.data[len(s.data)-1]`
3. `IsEmpty`: change `len(s.data) > 0` to `len(s.data) == 0`
All 4 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
